text: New student should take Entrance Examination before attending classes, arranged as follows: Arts: Chinese, Math, English, Arts comprehensive exam (Arts comprehensive exam includes: Background of China and mordern world history) Science: Chinese, Math, English and Science comprehensive exam (Science Comprehensive exam includes: physics, chemistry and biology) Program Description Applied chemistry is a culture with the basic knowledge of chemistry, the basic theories, basic skills and related knowledge of engineering technology and strong experimental skills, has a chemical basic research and applied basic research of scientific thinking and science experiment training, in scientific research institutions, institutions of higher learning and enterprises and institutions engaged in scientific research, teaching and management discipline senior specialized talents. Duration 3 years
